feeds.title: A Modern Homestead Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to homestead wherever you are with from scratch recipes, crafting patterns, gardening info, canning recipes, and more.

feeds.title: Imperfectly Happy Homesteading
feeds.description: Sustainable Living, Self Sufficiency, Homeschooling, DIY, Backyard Farming, Preserving, and Vintage Skills for the modern homesteader. Authored by Tiffany Davis, a Phoenix-based backyard homesteader.

feeds.title: The Rustic Elk
feeds.description: Modern homesteading on only an acre of land. Self-sufficient living tips and real food recipes for your family farm table.

feeds.title: Homestead and Chill Blog
feeds.description: I'm Deanna and this blog is about living simply, getting my hands dirty, infusing plants into every aspect of life, and imparting natural wellness to our little family and ecosystem the best I can. My hope is to inspire love for a similar lifestyle or hobbies in others, by sharing real-life tips and tools to make modern homesteading and related activities easy, understandable, and enjoyable ~ so you can learn and dive in with me.

feeds.title: An English Homestead
feeds.description: Stay at home dad to two girls & a boy, husband, homesteader, small farmer, small-time shepherd, big-time veg gardener, love cooking & baking.

feeds.title: The Modern Day Settler
feeds.description: Welcome to a glimpse of life on my 1790s New England Farm where you will find information on everything from milking a goat, to artificially inseminating a sow, and everything in between. I hope you enjoy and will stick around.

feeds.title: Small Farm Nation Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Tim. My passion is helping sustainable farmers to grow their farm business and help farmers to improve marketing and grow their farm businesses so they can create real change in local food communities.

feeds.title: The Hip Homestead Blog
feeds.description: The Hip Homestead is a Home, Garden and Lifestyle blog for Modern Homesteaders. The goal is to educate and entertain those of you looking to transition into a more sustainable & self-sufficient life. Whether you are on a suburban lot like me or running a hobby farm in the country, the aim is to provide you with fun, educational information that makes your life a little easier.

feeds.title: Homestead Honey
feeds.description: Homestead Honey is a radical homesteading blog, off the grid living, off the grid blog, Waldorf-inspired homeschooling, coaching programs for women & more! Teri's passion is connecting with, educating, and inspiring people who are ready to take a giant leap toward the simple, sustainable life they want for their families.

feeds.title: The Reid Homestead
feeds.description: Tamara shares organic gardening tips and ideas, backyard vegetable gardening, DIY garden projects, homesteading, chickens, food preservation, self sustainable lifestyle.

feeds.title: Sage & Shepherd Farm Blog
feeds.description: We're Abbagail & Mackenzie McRuer. We started Sage & Shepherd Farm soon after we got married. Then we said why can't we grow our own meat too?. We fell in love with farming and the ability to control where our food comes from. Our two dogs, Aslan the Great Pyrenees, and Levi the German Shepherd (hence sage and shepherd), and many farm animals keep us busy, as well as cooking, being outside, hiking with our dogs, eating, and gardening.

feeds.title: Frenchie Farm
feeds.description: Frenchie Farm is a health and wellness blog dedicated to homesteading. Follow along as we renovate our farmhouse and raise goats and chickens.

feeds.title: Our Smallholding Adventure
feeds.description: We're a family of 4 based in the North East of England and welcome you to follow us on our frugal journey from street house to small holding, fast food to self-sufficiency (well as much as possible) and shop bought to homemade. The highs and lows will all be recorded with lots of pictures along the way. From livestock to veggies and rides out on the horses to countryside walks with the dogs, we plan on making the most of every minute.

feeds.title: Sunshine Farm
feeds.description: Welcome to Our Little Sunshine Farm! Follow our journey and learn about all of the highs and lows of living on a small farm. Right now we have eleven animals on the farm: two indoor cats, one golden retriever, six chickens (all hens), one miniature horse, and a thoroughbred mare.
